sources.title: ACETADOTE (acetylcysteine) US prescribing information
sources.observation: Approved acetaminophen-overdose antidote; total terminal half-life 5.6 h; binding 66-87%; molecular weight 163.2.
sources.contrary_or_limit: No chronic chromosome-instability indication; binding does not identify reduced-parent target-tissue exposure.
sources.evidence_access: Full FDA PDF, indication and section 12.3 inspected

sources.title: Oxidative stress induces chromosomal instability through replication stress in fibroblasts from aged mice
sources.model: Primary ear fibroblasts from young and aged C57BL/6J mice, 3% oxygen
sources.observation: Live-imaged mitoses showed reduced lagging chromosomes and bridges; rescue incomplete.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Not BUB1B mutant; high nominal exposure, no human unbound/tissue bridge.
sources.evidence_access: Full primary article; Fig 4 and methods inspected

sources.title: Sod1 deficiency in mouse oocytes during in vitro maturation increases chromosome segregation errors with a reduced BUBR1 at kinetochore
sources.model: Sod1-null mouse oocytes during in-vitro maturation
sources.observation: Primary abstract/search excerpts report fewer segregation errors with 500 micromolar NAC.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Different genotype and meiosis; detailed full text unstable; no NAC-to-BUBR1-localization rescue claim extracted.
sources.evidence_access: Primary PubMed/PMC search excerpts; publisher landing page, subsequent detail requests timed out

sources.title: The disposition and kinetics of intravenous N-acetylcysteine in patients with paracetamol overdosage
sources.observation: Mean total-plasma early peak 554 mg/L; approximately 35 mg/L after 12 h.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Historical acute poisoning, transient total concentration, not free reduced NAC or sustained tissue exposure; no chronic-use extrapolation.

sources.title: Pharmacokinetics and bioavailability of reduced and oxidized N-acetylcysteine
sources.model: Six healthy volunteers, crossover route comparison
sources.observation: Reduced oral bioavailability 4.0%; total 9.1%; reduced intravenous terminal half-life 1.95 h versus total 5.58 h.
sources.contrary_or_limit: Small study; no chromosome-instability endpoint or relevant tissue measurements; reduced and total analytes not interchangeable.
sources.evidence_access: Primary publisher abstract inspected; full text subscription only
